title: pmrigid_open_string_2d
description: `pmrigid_open_string_2d` implements a simple two-dimensional physical model of an open string, producing the positions of its moving masses as a list and supporting correlated outputs from few inputs. Its arguments set the number of moving masses, rigidity, and damping; its first two inputs position the first and last masses, while other inputs apply forces and adjust rigidity and damping.
